description: This Java source file defines a final class `JMSMessageWorkaround` that extends `JmsMessage`. The class acts as a wrapper around a JMS message to override certain behaviors, especially to prevent the Qpid client from setting AMQP properties improperly. It provides a static method `wrap()` to create a wrapped instance and delegates most method calls to the underlying message object while overriding specific setter methods to do nothing in some cases.

classes.name: JMSMessageWorkaround
classes.description: A wrapper class for `JmsMessage` to override certain methods, primarily to prevent setting AMQP properties inappropriately. Delegates most methods to the wrapped message instance.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a new `JMSMessageWorkaround` instance wrapping the provided `JmsMessage`. The wrapped message should not be used elsewhere after wrapping.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the wrapper, including the class name and the wrapped message's string form.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the wrapped message, wrapped in a new `JMSMessageWorkaround`.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the wrapped message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality against another object, delegating to the wrapped message.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Delegates acknowledge call to the wrapped message.

methods.name: getJMSMessageID
methods.description: Retrieves the message ID from the wrapped message.

methods.name: setJMSMessageID
methods.description: Sets the message ID if it is currently null.

methods.name: setJMSTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp if it is currently zero.

methods.name: getJMSCorrelationIDAsBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID as bytes.
